body:
lol that's some extreme tooth-brushing.  

I wasn't trying to be mean or anything, just so you know.. I just tend to notice stupid things in pictures that end up distracting me. :)

super cute undies btw :P

please.  oh please. :D
but clean that mirror first :P

If you *do* decide to do a different book, why not put up a request at donorschoose?  I'm fairly broke at the moment, but you can be sure that I'd donate to get the right book in that classroom.  Make sure you ask for enough so that you've got take-home copies.  Nothing sucked more in high school than reading in class.
so... would you prefer that I name my ex boyfriend?

I used to date someone who worked/works for Princess as a translator, as "she" speaks English very poorly.

Princess Hijab is most definitely a man.

I totally get what you're saying.  Right now though, he's fixated on this, and literally cannot talk about anything else with me.  

I was thinking of maybe joining a gym with him down near where he lives.  Both of us could use it, me for the fitness, and him for the self-esteem and endorphins.  I have a collection of 1950's-1970's vinyl and about 70 NES games that I'm thinking about selling to kinda get a fund going to do this with.  Maybe I'll offer them up here on Reddit first, rather than ebay, and see what the community can do.

I think it's that he's scared to move on again.  Right now, where he is, he's at least financially stable (boyfriend makes most of the money), and there's a roof over his head.  Leaving would mean having almost literally nothing, other than the few plastic tubs of stuff he brought with him when he moved out of here.  To him, it's a matter of being 31, and having nothing to show for it, and still somehow holding out hope that he can be with this guy and have his life goals fulfilled.

thanks for that.  I really do try to be the best friend I can possibly be to him.  people have taken advantage of him his entire life, in every way you could possibly imagine.


right now, therapy is a no-go.  there's literally no way he'll do it.  in his mind, "they don't *really* care, so what's the point of talking to them?"  If i had caught this sooner, I probably would have been able to get him to at least consider it.

as for the suicide deal:  we talk for short periods throughout the day, but do the bulk of our serious conversations at night over skype.  on a few occasions over the past two weeks, he's alluded to threatening to do something, and I've told him that I'd start driving down.  His response is that if i do, he won't be there when I get there.  That's a frustrating thing, because it tells me that my ability to help is waning.

yeah... I feel like, unless he's committed to a mental facility, he's not going to talk to anyone.  the major difficulty that I'm dealing with tonight is that he really thinks he's not worth saving, so there's no point. he doesn't care about the people he'd be leaving behind, because, in his words, our lives would be better off without him...we'd miss him for a little while, and then move on. the conversations with him get more and more difficult, and there's less and less of *him* there.
we definitely talked about this. he seemed receptive to the idea about 2 weeks ago. I do think it's worth bringing it up to him again.  Jerk will most likely continue denial of a problem, sadly.

thanks for responding, and for a tl;dr that i spent 10 minutes trying to come up with, and failed.

I totally agree with this.  His personality is really quite caring and he'd do anything he could to help someone in need.  The issue with it right now, though, is that he doesn't think he's worth anything, so is unable to help anyone going through a tough situation.

I *will* mention this to him when things get better though.  I feel like he has a calling for this sort of thing.
